EC1: Patients with liver disease [AND] (documented liver function test abnormality)
EC2: Patients with renal disease [AND] (documented glomerular filtration rate < 60mL/min/1.73m2)
EC3: Patients with a baseline (pre-operative) opioid use greater than 30 mg of morphine equivalents/day.
EC5: Patients with active illicit drug dependence
EC6: Patients < 18 years of age [OR] and >70 years of age
EC7: Patients allergic [AND] to any medication given in either arm (list medications)
EC8: Patients who have a seizure disorder
